item.description: ### Added - **Antigravity CLI sessions now count in Stats.** The heatmap, streaks, session counts and active time include `agy` conversations, read from the CLI's own transcripts, with an Antigravity segment in the provider picker on the Mac and iPhone; the watch's all-provider totals include it. Token totals and the model breakdown stay "unavailable" for it — the CLI keeps no token counts or model names on disk, so Perch says so rather than showing zero. The iPhone now says so too: a provider with no token history reads "—" instead of "0". Conversations the CLI opened but you never typed into are not counted.
